derivation_rules.escape_bounded: For truncated compact cells the certified witness bounds the extras from above: best_cost <= witness endpoint cost and minimum barrier <= witness peak cost.  The witness endpoint must improve on the baseline.
derivation_rules.escape_enumerated: When the compact ball enumeration completed, best_cost and barrier_height are exact and the IDA* minimum escape depth must agree with the compact escape depth.
derivation_rules.local_optimum: IDA* proves no improving state exists in the horizon ball.  The initial state is in the ball, so best_cost = baseline_cost exactly.  No improving path exists, so the barrier quantity is vacuous.
derivation_rules.witness_replay: every replayed witness must reapply through replay_actions against the hash-checked root state

identity_checks: both packages cover exactly the same 128 source ids
initial_state_sha256 agreement per source (root state also rebuilt and hash-checked)
compact EXACT_ESCAPE implies matching IDA* EXACT_ESCAPE with equal minimum escape depth
a truncated compact cell with a recorded witness cannot be a local optimum
purpose: Integrate the frozen v14 compact exact panel and the frozen v14 IDA* panel into one classification-complete statement for the same 128-source panel.  No search is rerun and no frozen package is modified.
resource_contracts: none; this package consumes frozen evidence only
